title: Integration: The Big Open Questions
objective: After this level you can describe the major unanswered questions in astronomy and why they matter.
summary: About 95% of the universe is dark and unexplained. The Hubble tension, what came before the Big Bang and life elsewhere are all open.

cards.headline: The best part of astronomy: it isn’t finished.
cards.body: Here are some of the biggest questions still waiting for answers.

cards.headline: The dark 95%
cards.body: Dark matter and dark energy together make up about 95% of the universe, and nobody yet knows what either one is. Ordinary matter, everything we can see, is only about 5%.

cards.headline: Unsolved puzzles
cards.body: Different ways of measuring how fast the universe expands today disagree slightly, a puzzle called the Hubble tension. Why the Sun’s corona is so much hotter than its surface isn’t fully understood. And no one knows what, if anything, came before the Big Bang.

cards.context: No life has yet been confirmed anywhere beyond Earth. Webb can now study the atmospheres of some other worlds for the gases life might leave behind.
